reason: The carousel is a concept for a scam-check tool, not a service I can hire. It shows a WhatsApp chat about an M-Pesa message and never says what an agent would do for my business, so I can't tell what I'd be paying for. I already have a designer and a team that handles client messages.
objection: We already have a designer. Why would I pay a studio for AI agents when they haven't shown me one working on a business like mine?
would_change_my_mind: A live demo run on a sample of my own customer messages, showing the drafts it would send and how many I would have to fix, with a short trial before any commitment.
